name: thunderbird-mcp
description: Connects Claude Desktop to the local Thunderbird MCP bridge.
long_description: A local MCP server for reading, searching, drafting, sending, and organizing Thunderbird messages. Safe autonomous replies require a content-bound preview, durable idempotency, explicit confirmation, and reconciliation.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check whether Thunderbird and the local native bridge are connected.

tools.name: get_current_message
tools.description: Read the message currently displayed in Thunderbird.

tools.name: get_current_messages
tools.description: Read all messages currently displayed in Thunderbird.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search Thunderbird messages using compact paged results by default.

tools.name: poll_messages
tools.description: Poll messages using an explicit durable date/account/folder/RFC-id/Thunderbird-id watermark and normalized automation headers.

tools.name: continue_search
tools.description: Return the next page from a previous message or attachment search.

tools.name: close_search
tools.description: Release a previous paged search token when no more results are needed.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read a Thunderbird message by its current internal message id.

tools.name: get_message_headers
tools.description: Read decoded RFC 822 headers for a Thunderbird message.

tools.name: get_raw_message
tools.description: Read capped raw RFC 822 message source as text or base64.

tools.name: list_message_text_parts
tools.description: List Thunderbird inline text parts for a message.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List attachments for a message or the currently displayed message.

tools.name: search_attachments
tools.description: Search messages with attachments using compact paged results and concurrent attachment inspection.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Retrieve text or explicitly requested base64 content for one attachment.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Read text-like attachment contents by message id and part name.

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Return capped base64 attachment bytes by message id and part name.

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Save an attachment locally using chunked reads.

tools.name: open_attachment
tools.description: Open an attachment in Thunderbird or the OS handler.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List configured Thunderbird accounts and folders.

tools.name: open_compose
tools.description: Open a Thunderbird compose window. This never sends mail.

tools.name: create_reply_draft
tools.description: Open and optionally save a Thunderbird reply draft. This never sends mail.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Compose and send or queue a new Thunderbird message, requiring confirmSend=true.

tools.name: preview_reply
tools.description: Resolve and approve the exact safe reply envelope with a short-lived content-bound token.

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Idempotently send exactly a prior preview using replyToSender and sendNow.

tools.name: get_send_status
tools.description: Read the durable receipt for a reply operation without sending.

tools.name: reconcile_send
tools.description: Reconcile an uncertain reply against connector evidence and Sent/Outbox.

tools.name: send_current_compose
tools.description: Send or queue an existing compose tab, requiring confirmSend=true.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List Thunderbird message tags.

tools.name: update_message
tools.description: Update read, flagged, junk, or tag state for a Thunderbird message.

tools.name: archive_messages
tools.description: Archive messages using Thunderbird's configured archive settings.

tools.name: move_messages
tools.description: Move messages to a Thunderbird folder.

tools.name: copy_messages
tools.description: Copy messages to a Thunderbird folder.

tools.name: delete_messages
tools.description: Delete messages through Thunderbird, requiring confirmDelete=true.

prompts.name: draft_reply
prompts.description: Draft a reply to the current Thunderbird message.
prompts.text: Read the current Thunderbird message, summarize it, and create a reply draft. Do not send the message.

prompts.name: triage_current_message
prompts.description: Summarize the current Thunderbird message and extract action items.
prompts.text: Read the current Thunderbird message, summarize it, extract action items, and suggest whether a reply is needed.
